title: IAmAVirus: one move through fog
scope: Source-checked review of the immutable v38 package; presentation preparation, not a new release.
rule: The arena ends when a mover leaves its own king capturable. Attacking the other king alone does not end the game.
cards: Read our 64-square private view and clock. A hidden square is unknown; it is not a visibly empty square.
Advance weighted possible positions through compatible moves. Merge native position keys. The configured retained-population cap is 200,000.
Apply root king/queen risk guards. Normally draw 32 worlds by weight with replacement; merge repeated draws into chance branches.
Build one local game tree. Stockfish depth-1 child scoring sees both sides on each complete imagined board, not the live true board.
PRM+ compares each action with the current mixture using counterfactual values. These regret updates happen inside this move, not across old games.
Execute the highest-probability permitted root action. Retain belief/front-end history. Discard the FoW tree and regret arrays before the next move.
example_title: A real prefix: 128 positions → 32 draws → 2 branches
example: Both branches share one root strategy across 39 actions. The sampler keeps all 128 positions in belief for later observations.
example_limit: Fresh two-second reconstruction of c8ozqj0m, White decision 5. Both local runs choose g1f3; the recorded arena action is c2c3. This is a teaching trace.
memory: Belief and front-end history survive between moves. Stockfish can retain its own cache. The FoW tree is rebuilt; coefficients and history counts stay frozen between uploads.
evidence: 1.57–1.68× scorer throughput; about 38% more equal-time nodes on the fixed panel. Scores change: the scorer is approximate. The failed Misty gate remains failed; the arena trial was separately authorized.

Replay panel: 63 games, only two IAmAVirus observers; truth-log-share gain +0.47277 nats. The full-engine pilot ends 1W–8L under futility, seven legs unstarted; all 901 frames pass rules checks. Configuration closed.
11 Nov, 03:27 UTC: 339W–27D–254L in 620 games; raw score 56.9%. The later 493 games track v37's historical same-opponent level. Changing opponents and scheduling limit causal claims.
limitations: Capping can lose the real position; weighting can underrate it; a small sample can omit it. These are separate failure modes.
One representative opponent history per position. Opponent-compatible past alternatives, full 2-KLUSS gadgets and cross-turn blueprint reuse are absent from v38.
Stockfish is a perfect-information evaluator on imagined boards. No qualified learned FoW frontier value replaces it.
The root takes an argmax. World-sampling randomness is distinct from drawing an action from the computed mixed strategy. No full-game Nash certificate.
Raw collection, taxonomy, exported examples, fitting and packaged models advance separately. Historical metadata and holdout limitations remain explicit.
learning: Shipped: two 28-coefficient move models and one 359,889-record history file; borrowed Stockfish NNUE. The historical CNN–GRU/PPO policy and neural regret approximation do not play in v38.
stance: Our contribution is native implementation, replay instrumentation and measured engineering around published ideas. Faster scoring is established on its panel; a lasting arena strength gain is not established.
sources: Confirmed prior and rejected playing pilot
